label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter 'BlCurated00024' flows directly into bar via replace("\"", """). The replacement only escapes literal quote characters, which is insufficient to prevent script tags (<script>) or other event handlers (onclick=...) from executing. Since the resulting bar value is concatenated unescaped into an HTML attribute within the response, it constitutes a genuine XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: Parameter read from request and weakly sanitized (only quotes escaped), then injected unsafely into HTML attribute
